name: SQLBits 2027
description: large Microsoft data platform conference: SQL Server, Fabric, Azure data
note: on-site, English; super-early-bird for 2027 via access code (no amounts published)
dateNote: 2027 dates not announced; last edition 22-25 Apr 2026 (ICC Wales, Newport)
details:
SQLBits is Europe's largest data platform conference, focused on SQL Server, Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and data engineering, with training days followed by conference days and a free community day.

The official site says the 2027 dates are not announced yet; venues alternate between UK cities (2025 ExCeL London, 2026 ICC Wales Newport).
